text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I won... I claimed it...! 
Haha! Yes... YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah, haaah... 
Nnnrgh! That is SO frustrating!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I set out to defeat both the foreign and 
Japanese horse girls 
to prove that I was the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My condition was perfect! I had total 
confidence! 
Even so... sí, I must admit it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno! Today, you were the stronger one 
desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I definitely... DEFINITELY will 
not lose deee-su!! 
I am taking back that championship belt, 
just you wait!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Bring all you have. 
No matter how many times you try, I shall 
turn you aside.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Today, I claimed victory. 
Yet... next time...)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaahhhhhh!" 
"Ngh...! Haaaaaaaaahhhh!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, ...I felt true terror. 
At the way her finishing kick found yet 
another gear.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Looking solely at the result, I bested El. 
I am the victor. 
Yet, race conditions favored me as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I must not grow complacent. I must 
redouble my efforts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations!" "What an incredible 
race!" 
"Man, that was something special!" 
"Races these days have been completely on 
fire!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(And... what is this fervor...? 
This "groundswell" that I could never 
create on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Seriously amazing! 
So this is the level of Japanese racing 
today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, they can take on the entire 
world...! 
Heh! I'm definitely coming back to cheer 
for you guys!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(By crossing swords with El and the others 
today— 
we have convinced even the spectators.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of the sheer "strength" of Japanese 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(El and her peers possess races with the 
power... 
to transmit that conviction to all who 
watch.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So this... is the kind of racing 
they have been building...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...I have returned.
choice_data_list: Congratulations! That was a splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. 
Yet, good fortune played its part as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, this is not enough. I must 
not let a victory 
that fell into my lap get to my head; I 
must press forward.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And that "groundswell" they brought about— 
I, too, shall create it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Only beyond that achievement 
lies the prosperity of the Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us return to the academy, 
Trainer. 
We have proper efforts to maintain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running the Japan Cup seemed to have 
stirred 
something within Phalaenopsis. I prayed 
that this 
would serve as a welcome inspiration—
